title: OpenAI Says It Is Collaborating With Samsung to Develop the Next-Generation Chip, and the Collaboration Is Deepening

content_html:
Harrison Kim, General Manager of OpenAI in South Korea, said at a press conference on Wednesday: "One of the areas where we have made the most significant progress and received the most recognition in our collaboration with Samsung Electronics is joint production and research for the next-generation chips we are developing."

Kim also stated that Samsung Electronics is "one of the largest companies in the world using ChatGPT," and the company's employees in South Korea and overseas use ChatGPT in areas such as R&D, marketing, and sales.

He also pointed out that as chip technologies continue to advance to enable faster and more complex computations, the demand for memory chips will continue to grow, making collaboration with South Korean semiconductor suppliers a priority for OpenAI's local office.
